definition: Unique identifier for the patient.
Unique identifier for the healthcare encounter/visit.
String representation of the unique 3-character ICD code prefixes associated with the encounter.
Number of unique 3-character ICD code prefixes recorded for the encounter.
Datetime when the encounter began.
Datetime when the encounter ended.
Duration of the encounter in days.
Care setting for the encounter, such as inpatient, outpatient, emergency, or observation.
Clinical service line or specialty associated with the encounter.
Ordered string of ADT event types during the encounter (for example admission, transfer, discharge).
Ordered string of timestamps corresponding to the ADT events during the encounter.
Patient year of birth.
Recorded sex of the patient.
Recorded race and/or ethnicity category for the patient.
Indicator for whether the patient is recorded as deceased.
Patient age at the time of the encounter.
Number of unique medication orders placed during the encounter.
Ordered string of procedure codes recorded during the encounter.
Ordered string of procedure descriptions corresponding to the procedure codes.
Ordered string of timestamps for procedures during the encounter.
Total number of procedures recorded during the encounter.
Number of prior encounters for the patient before this encounter.
Total number of procedures across all prior encounters.
Total number of ICD codes across all prior encounters.
Total days spent across all prior encounters.
Cluster or grouped category assigned to the encounter, likely derived from utilization, diagnosis, or procedure patterns.
